units.source_text: 她穿的裙子，已经不像是西装，而像是在身上缠上一块不干净的布。

en.t: The skirt she was wearing no longer looked like Western clothing, but like a dirty piece of cloth wrapped around her body.

units.source_text: 她就像一个地道的日本人，背着一个大包袱回去了。

en.t: Like a completely ordinary Japanese person, she went back carrying a large bundle on her back.
Even so, she was still wearing leather boots on her feet.
